name: kb-multimodal-describer-closeout
title: Close out placeholder audio/video describers in knowledge-base ingest
description: Resolve the mismatch where knowledge-base forms expose audio/video model selection while the live RAG ingest path still uses placeholder describers that return empty content.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-22 completed: retracted admin/tenant KB audio-video model selectors, reject audio/video KB model overrides at the backend command seam, and fail closed before the live processor can instantiate placeholder describers. Audio/video ingest now returns the existing explicit unsupported-runtime errors instead of flowing through empty-content placeholder describers.
